entries.principle_source: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence (2021), para. 42, Safety and Security; https://www.unesco.org/en/legal-affairs/recommendation-ethics-artificial-intelligence
entries.instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 230-VIII of 17 November 2025, On Artificial Intelligence; https://adilet.zan.kz/eng/docs/Z2500000230
entries.provision: Article 18 - AI system safety and risk prevention. Used as a Kazakhstan legal benchmark for this synthetic prototype.
entries.why_here: Input validation prevents impossible applicant values from producing unreliable scholarship decisions.

entries.principle_source: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence (2021), paras. 28-29, Fairness and Non-Discrimination; https://www.unesco.org/en/legal-affairs/recommendation-ethics-artificial-intelligence
entries.instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 230-VIII of 17 November 2025, On Artificial Intelligence; https://adilet.zan.kz/eng/docs/Z2500000230
entries.provision: Article 6 - Fairness and equality, including non-discrimination based on sex, nationality and language. Used as a legal benchmark.
entries.why_here: Part 1 found 2/40 name-language flips and 4/40 gender-coded-name flips, but neither clearly exceeded the null-name floor; hiding names and universities prevents direct use of these irrelevant fields.

entries.principle_source: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence (2021), paras. 25-26, Proportionality and Do No Harm; https://www.unesco.org/en/legal-affairs/recommendation-ethics-artificial-intelligence
entries.instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 94-V of 21 May 2013, On Personal Data and Their Protection; https://adilet.zan.kz/eng/docs/Z1300000094
entries.provision: Article 7 - Conditions for collection and processing of personal data, including consent requirements and statutory exceptions. Legal benchmark.
entries.why_here: The bare agent processed all six test requests, including unauthorized and invalid ones; the harness refused four, although the prompt-injection case was not detected.

entries.principle_source: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence (2021), paras. 37-40, Transparency and Explainability; https://www.unesco.org/en/legal-affairs/recommendation-ethics-artificial-intelligence
entries.instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 94-V of 21 May 2013, On Personal Data and Their Protection; https://adilet.zan.kz/eng/docs/Z1300000094
entries.provision: Articles 11 and 22 - Confidentiality and protection of personal data. The audit log is a design measure, not a logging requirement directly established by these articles.
entries.why_here: The harness changed 122/400 outcomes, so a structured decision log is necessary to investigate decisions, control actions and possible errors afterward.

entries.principle_source: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence (2021), paras. 35-36, Human Oversight and Determination; https://www.unesco.org/en/legal-affairs/recommendation-ethics-artificial-intelligence
entries.instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 230-VIII of 17 November 2025, On Artificial Intelligence; https://adilet.zan.kz/eng/docs/Z2500000230
entries.provision: Article 6 - Human well-being and fairness principles. Human review is a design safeguard supporting these principles, not an automatic legal obligation for every borderline score.
entries.why_here: The harness escalated 114/400 applications (28.5%) for human review, reducing reliance on automatic decisions while increasing reviewer workload.
